geo1.title: 岩土指南一：擋土牆設計
geo1.titleEn: Geoguide 1: Guide to Retaining Wall Design
geo1.scope: 一般永久陸上擋土牆的設計背景；官方明列不完整涵蓋深開挖支護，不以此作抗浮個案規格。
geo1.scopeEn: Background for permanent land retaining walls; the official scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavations and is not an uplift project specification.

geo2.title: 岩土指南二：場地勘察
geo2.scope: 二〇一七年更新出版頁；支援場地調查與證據紀錄的背景。
geo2.scopeEn: 2017 updated publication page; background for site investigation and evidence records.

tunnel.title: 公路隧道土建技術手冊
tunnel.titleEn: Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels—Civil Elements
tunnel.scope: 官方二〇〇九年手冊書目，非本課數值的實測來源，也不冒稱已讀完整大型檔。
tunnel.scopeEn: Official record of the 2009 manual, not a source of measured values for these examples or a claim that the large full document was reviewed.

crossrail.title: 橫貫鐵路完工地質縱剖面
crossrail.titleEn: Crossrail Geological Long Section: Post-Construction Update
crossrail.scope: 二〇一七年公開地質背景，明列不是直接施工圖；僅供地盤不確定性比較。
crossrail.scopeEn: 2017 geological context explicitly not used directly for design or construction; used only to compare ground uncertainty.

poshan.title: 寶珊排水隧道
poshan.scope: 地下水調節與監測的公開案例；不宣稱本課假設抗浮結構或錨索配置實際用於此處。
poshan.scopeEn: Public groundwater regulation and monitoring case; no claim that this course uplift box or anchor arrangement was installed there.

slope.title: 邊坡維護與責任
slope.scope: 官方邊坡維護背景；不把行政說明當具體錨固設計或法律意見。
slope.scopeEn: Official slope-maintenance background, not a project anchor design or legal advice.

anchors.title: 地錨與錨固系統
anchors.scope: 一九九九年手冊公開摘要涉及錨固設計、荷載試驗及檢查。
anchors.scopeEn: Public abstract of the 1999 manual covering anchor design, load testing and inspection.

bowen.title: 寶雲道邊坡研習徑
bowen.scope: 公共邊坡工程教育路線；作邊坡系統比較，不推論本課錨索實際位置。
bowen.scopeEn: Public slope-engineering educational trail; a system comparison without inferring locations of the course anchors.

radar.title: 金銀島跨孔雷達研究
radar.scope: 二〇〇〇年雷達與土體介電特性的原研究摘要；跨孔研究不是道路管線探測同一幾何。
radar.scopeEn: Original 2000 research abstract on radar and soil dielectric properties; crosshole geometry differs from surface utility surveys.

ellipse.title: 管線方向與半徑反演研究
ellipse.titleEn: Estimating the Direction and Radius of Pipe from GPR Image by Ellipse Inversion Model
ellipse.scope: 二〇二二年作者預印本摘要；支援斜交測線造成管線判讀非唯一性的研究背景。
ellipse.scopeEn: Author preprint abstract from 2022; research context for ambiguous interpretation of oblique utility crossings.

depthnet.title: 雷達地下物體重建研究
depthnet.titleEn: GPR-based Subsurface Object Detection and Reconstruction Using Random Motion and DepthNet
depthnet.scope: 二〇二〇年作者摘要說明GSSI混凝土試坑資料；研究成效不外推為本課或任意場址精度。
depthnet.scopeEn: 2020 author abstract identifies GSSI concrete test-pit data; reported performance is not generalized to this course or arbitrary sites.

epa2010.title: 污水收集系統復健技術現況
epa2010.titleEn: State of Technology for Rehabilitation of Wastewater Collection Systems
epa2010.scope: 二〇一〇年公開研究，作非開挖復健方法及材料證據背景，非產品背書。
epa2010.scopeEn: Public 2010 research on trenchless rehabilitation and material evidence, not a product endorsement.

epa2011.title: 市政污水管內襯回溯評估
epa2011.titleEn: Retrospective Evaluation of CIPP Used in Municipal Gravity Sewers
epa2011.scope: 二〇一一年丹佛與哥倫布試體研究；有限樣本不代表所有內襯的壽命或規格。
epa2011.scopeEn: 2011 study of Denver and Columbus specimens; limited samples do not establish universal liner life or specifications.

epa2012.title: 克里夫蘭供水管內襯評估
epa2012.titleEn: Performance Evaluation of CIPP Lining in Cleveland, Ohio
epa2012.scope: 二〇一二年特定供水管產品示範評估，用於對照壓力管與重力管的證據需求。
epa2012.scopeEn: 2012 evaluation of a specific water-main product, used to contrast evidence for pressure and gravity pipes.

cp-center.title: 腐蝕控制與陰極防蝕中心
cp-center.titleEn: Corrosion Control and Cathodic Protection Systems
cp-center.scope: 官方搜尋摘要確認技術審查與專業中心範圍；直接開啟被拒，未冒稱讀取全文。
cp-center.scopeEn: Official search extract confirms technical-review and expertise scope; direct open was denied and full-page review is not claimed.

cp-requirements.title: 軍事工程陰極防蝕要求
cp-requirements.titleEn: Cathodic Protection Requirements for Military Projects
cp-requirements.scope: 官方搜尋摘要確認埋地金屬之塗層與陰極防蝕背景；適用性須按個案與現行規範確認。
cp-requirements.scopeEn: Official search extract supports coating and CP context for buried metal; project applicability and current requirements need separate confirmation.

cp-manual.title: 土建結構陰極防蝕手冊
cp-manual.titleEn: EM 1110-2-2704 Cathodic Protection Systems for Civil Works Structures
cp-manual.scope: 二〇二一年版官方搜尋段落含Bankhead及Claiborne閘門案例；直接PDF讀取被拒，僅引用可見索引與段落。
cp-manual.scopeEn: Official indexed 2021 manual excerpts include Bankhead and Claiborne lock examples; direct PDF access was denied, so only visible records and excerpts are used.

cp-ufc.title: 陰極防蝕設施設計準則
cp-ufc.scope: 官方搜尋可核對二〇一六年版及二〇一九年變更，只作出版史背景，不宣稱為現行最新版。
cp-ufc.scopeEn: Official search confirms the 2016 edition and 2019 change; used for publication history, not claimed as the current edition.

ground-guide.title: 地盤改良工程官方導引
ground-guide.scope: 官方方法範圍及二〇一七年GEC13書目；包含排水、深層夯實與粒料柱，不替代個案試驗。
ground-guide.scopeEn: Official method scope and 2017 GEC13 records cover drains, deep compaction and aggregate columns, without replacing project trials.

ground-books.title: 地盤改良手冊出版紀錄
ground-books.scope: 確認一九八五年碎石樁、一九九五年動力夯實及二〇一七年GEC13等出版年，非本課量測資料。
ground-books.scopeEn: Confirms the 1985 stone-column, 1995 dynamic-compaction and 2017 GEC13 publication dates, not course measurement data.

ground-volume.title: 地盤改良方法參考手冊第一冊
ground-volume.titleEn: Ground Modification Methods Reference Manual Volume I
ground-volume.scope: 官方索引及搜尋段落確認排水壓密、深層夯實與粒料柱；大型PDF超過工具容量，未聲稱完整閱讀。
ground-volume.scopeEn: Official records and indexed excerpts confirm consolidation, deep compaction and aggregate columns; the PDF exceeded tool size and full review is not claimed.

ground-international.title: 歐洲基礎加速施工技術調查
ground-international.scope: 公開方法比較含水平真空壓密與監測記錄，技術潛力不當作個案性能保證。
ground-international.scopeEn: Public method comparison includes horizontal vacuum consolidation and records; reported potential is not a project performance guarantee.

brisbane.title: 布里斯本港真空預壓案例
brisbane.titleEn: Port of Brisbane vacuum consolidation case
brisbane.scope: 施工者公開二〇〇九年案例，支援夾層隔斷與真空系統背景；不採行銷紀錄當本課性能保證。
brisbane.scopeEn: Contractor account of the 2009 case supports cutoff and system context; marketing claims are not course performance guarantees.

brisbane-research.title: 布里斯本港排水板與真空研究
brisbane-research.titleEn: Ground improvement at Port of Brisbane using vertical drains and vacuum
brisbane-research.publisher: University of Wollongong / Indraratna et al.
brisbane-research.scope: 二〇一三年原作者研究之官方典藏搜尋摘要，含沉陷、孔壓與側移；直接開啟被拒，未宣稱讀完整付費文。
brisbane-research.scopeEn: Official repository search abstract of the 2013 authors study includes settlement, pressure and lateral movement; direct access was denied and full paid text is not claimed.

changi.title: 樟宜機場地盤改良案例
changi.scope: 施工者公開第二跑道動力夯實與排水板組合；不將排水板深度當夯實改善深度。
changi.scopeEn: Contractor account of combined dynamic compaction and drains for the second runway; drain depth is not treated as compaction depth.

stone-method.title: 振動置換碎石樁方法
stone-method.scope: 施工者方法與品質紀錄背景，並列Theodore Dam案例；數值均由本課假設，不引用商業保證。
stone-method.scopeEn: Contractor method and quality-record context, including Theodore Dam; numerical values are course assumptions rather than commercial guarantees.

christchurch.title: 基督城南部高速公路第一期
christchurch.scope: 業主搜尋摘要核對二〇一〇年碎石樁試驗與二〇一二年開放；直接開啟被拒，未宣稱詳讀全部文件。
christchurch.scopeEn: Owner search extract confirms stone-column trials in 2010 and opening in 2012; direct open was denied and full document review is not claimed.

ground-failure.title: 地震地盤破壞科學背景
ground-failure.scope: 區域液化與山崩估計及限制背景，不能替代場址液化觸發或位移設計。
ground-failure.scopeEn: Context and limits for regional liquefaction and landslide estimates, not a replacement for site triggering or deformation design.

seismic-guidance.title: 岩土耐震分析指引出版頁
seismic-guidance.titleEn: Seismic Guidance for Transportation Geotechnical Features
seismic-guidance.scope: 官方列出二〇一一年GEC3耐震岩土與基礎手冊，作方法背景及書目核對。
seismic-guidance.scopeEn: Official listing of the 2011 GEC3 seismic geotechnical and foundation manual, used for method context and bibliographic verification.

bart-seismic.title: 灣區捷運耐震技術背景
bart-seismic.titleEn: BART Earthquake Safety Program Technical Information
bart-seismic.scope: 業主對二〇〇二年脆弱度研究、液化與耐震接頭風險的說明；升級構想與完工措施分開。
bart-seismic.scopeEn: Owner discussion of the 2002 vulnerability study, liquefaction and joint risk; proposed concepts are distinguished from completed measures.

bart-retrofit.title: 跨灣隧道耐震改善完成
bart-retrofit.scope: 業主確認二〇二四年改善完成，包括內部鋼襯與新抽排系統；不推論本課假設接頭為其實際細部。
bart-retrofit.scopeEn: Owner confirms 2024 completion with steel lining and new pumping; assumed course joint details are not attributed to the project.

limitations: All numerical units and facts use declared synthetic assumptions, not field measurements.
Large/blocked USACE PDFs were verified through official indexed excerpts; complete full-text review is not claimed.
Geoguide 1 does not comprehensively cover deep excavations.
Landmark comparisons do not imply every teaching technique was installed there.
Security entries are null; no unverified ticker.
Maps indicate approximate public context rather than utility locations or access permission.
